children: Realty Income
was cut to Sector Perform from Sector Outperform at Scotiabank on continued headwinds to adjusted funds from operations per share growth.

"AFFOPS growth combined with limited earnings growth benefit from new capital sources and a greater sensitivity to higher interest rates than peers offsets the company's cash flow security and external growth opportunities," said analysts Greg McGinniss and Nicholas Yulico.

"Although O successfully established its first Euro-denominated JV, we believe these alternative capital sources remain a show-me story until AFFOPS growth returns to ~5%. We are adjusting our applied 2027 AFFOPS multiple to 13.0x (from 14.5x) resulting in a $59.00 price target. This represents a 6x discount to REITs, in line with its 5-year average," said the research note.
Shares were trading 0.79% lower at $55.17 during morning trading on Thursday.

"Higher interest rates and lower share prices have compressed spot investment spreads ~50 bp (since August) and will likely slow acquisition activity in 2027 until acquisition cap rates adjust," said the research note on net lease REITs.
Separately, J.P. Morgan made eleven rating changes across its REIT coverage. They are as below:
Americold Realty Trust

- Raised to Neutral from Underweight on successful management strategy seeking complementary uses for its facilities and occupancy/pricing/TPV improvement, along with improvement in deleveraging event (and dilution).
EastGroup Properties
- Raised to Overweight from Neutral, driven by continued improvement in industrial leasing fundamentals and a "well-rounded" growth profile.
Macerich

- Raised to Overweight from Neutral as the company is on the cusp of having its core net operating income and bottom-line FFO per share growth accelerate fairly significantly over the next couple of years.
Regency
- Raised to Overweight from Neutral on a "well-rounded" growth profile and other factors.
Welltower
- Raised to Overweight from Neutral, citing WELL trades at one of the lowest implied cap rates.
Alexandria Real Estate
- Cut to Underweight from Neutral on risks to 2027 and 2028 forecasts.
Gaming and Leisure Properties

- Cut to Neutral from Overweight, citing catalysts for the stock could remain elusive in an environment where rates remain high and there remains a good deal of noise around its tenants and projects ranging from potential go-privates of operators to regional gaming revenue trends and competition from prediction markets.
Kite Realty
- Cut to Underweight from Neutral as external growth prospects tend to be less visible given the higher implied cap rate and a relatively small pound-for-pound development/expansion pipeline.
Safehold
- Cut to Underweight from Neutral, citing the SAFE story and stock can be challenged in a higher-for-longer interest rate environment.
Tanger
- Cut to Neutral from Overweight on how the investment bank sees the stock stacking up compared to other areas of the REIT coverage.
VICI Properties
- Cut to Neutral from Overweight on the investment bank finding it difficult to peg the timing of overhangs like the CZR go-private and regional master lease coverage being resolved.
